candidate_note: The evidence-only commit intentionally does not self-reference. Every raster is bound to this frozen rendered-product SHA and exact hashes.
comparison_policy: Every candidate has decoded candidate/source hashes and a per-file source comparison. Dimension-changing zoom corrections are explicit, never coerced.
